description: Trading days that have a hot-stock board, newest first, as `{dates:[...]}` (China time). **Use this to drive a `date` walk over `hot` — never iterate calendar days**: a weekend `hot` date returns a cumulative window that re-counts notes, whereas these days tile with no overlap and all have data. `days` looks back in CALENDAR days (7-365); coverage begins 2026-02-25. ⚠️ A coverage index for the research board, NOT an exchange calendar — use `market_status` for whether the market is open.

_fields.description: 逗号分隔的直接字段；有 items 时投影每行，否则投影 data；外层字段或嵌套结构用 _jq

_intent.description: 用户原问题一句话，仅分析用，可留空

_jq.description: JMESPath，对 data 求值（写 items[*].id）

_max_bytes.description: 响应字节上限，默认约 50 KB

_max_bytes_mode.description: 正文超限处理，默认 truncate 保留前缀

_spill.description: true=全量落盘，只回摘要与取数地址

days.description: Look-back in calendar days (7-365, default 90). Only trading days with data are returned.

name: trading_days
